Changelog:
/hdebug has a new Sources tab that shows where every installed plugin came from, to help clean up your plugin list. Plugins are split into Official, Third-party and Dev, sorted by name, with author, version, whether each one is enabled, and the full repo URL for third-party plugins. Tags point out testing builds and plugins that are outdated, orphaned or removed.

Further down are three clean-up sections: Duplicates (plugins installed from more than one repo), Overlapping (plugins offered by more than one of your repos, including repos that only offer plugins another repo already has) and Unused third-party repos (custom repos none of your plugins came from). Everything is read from what Dalamud already has, so nothing is downloaded.

The Plugins tab has a new Freeze button that holds the table still so the numbers stop jumping while you read them. It turns light blue while frozen.

hdebug now remembers its options between restarts: the Hide idle and Hide self checkboxes, the spike threshold, Ignore loading screens and which Sources sections are open.
